title: Critical Biomarkers in Insulin Signaling and cAMP Mediated Salivary Secretion in Sjogren Syndrome
author: Chen, Zhou, et al.
materials: To further understand the molecular functions and pathways involved in DEGs, we performed an enrichment analysis using the DAVID database. The GO enrichment results showed that these DEGs play critical roles in regulating water transport, insulin secretion, and cell-cell signaling (Fig. 3A-C). Further KEGG enrichment analysis showed that insulin signaling is essential in regulating DEGs. Furthermore, salivary secretion and cAMP signaling significantly enriched KEGG (Fig. 3D).Fig. 3GO and KEGG enrichment analysis. A-C GO enrichment analysis of the DEGs. D KEGG enrichment analysis of the DEGs. GO, Gene Ontology; KEGG, Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes; DEGs, differentially expressed genes

steps.title: Extract submandibular glands from NOD mice
steps.instruction: Harvest submandibular gland tissue from NOD mice for downstream histology, RNA extraction, and analysis.

steps.title: Prepare 5 µm sections for H&E staining
steps.instruction: Section the harvested glands at 5 µm thickness, dewax with xylene, rehydrate through a graded ethanol series, stain with H&E reagent (Wuhan Servicebio Technology Co. LTD), and examine morphology by light microscopy.

substeps.instruction: Observe stained sections under a light microscope.

steps.title: Culture A253 epithelial cells
steps.instruction: Maintain A253 cells in RPMI‑1640 medium supplemented with 10 % fetal bovine serum in a humidified incubator at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, using cells in logarithmic growth phase.

steps.title: Seed cells for IFN‑γ treatment
steps.instruction: Prepare a cell suspension at 4 × 10⁵ cells · mL⁻¹, inoculate into a 6 cm dish containing RPMI‑1640 medium with glutamine, and allow cells to adhere before treatment.

steps.title: Treat cells with IFN‑γ and harvest
steps.instruction: Add 100 nM IFN‑γ to the adhered cells, incubate for 48 h, then collect cells for RNA extraction.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 nM IFN‑γ to the culture medium.
Incubate the treated cells for 48 hours.
Harvest cells and extract total RNA.

steps.title: Perform RT‑qPCR on extracted RNA
steps.instruction: Reverse‑transcribe the extracted RNA and quantify target gene expression by quantitative PCR.

steps.title: Hierarchical clustering of DEGs
steps.instruction: Use the “Pheatmap” package (v1.0.2) in R to perform bidirectional hierarchical clustering of differentially expressed genes based on Euclidean distance.

steps.title: Construct PPI network and identify hubs
steps.instruction: Retrieve protein‑protein interactions with STRING (v11.5), selecting genes with a total score > 0.4; visualize the network in Cytoscape (v3.8.2) and detect hub modules using the MCODE plug‑in and degree analysis in cytoHumba.

substeps.instruction: Identify hub modules with MCODE and degree plug‑ins in cytoHumba.

steps.title: GO and KEGG enrichment analysis
steps.instruction: Submit the DEG list to the DAVID database to obtain Gene Ontology and KEGG pathway enrichment results, focusing on water transport, insulin secretion, cell‑cell signaling, salivary secretion, and cAMP signaling.

steps.title: Statistical analysis of experimental data
steps.instruction: Analyze data with GraphPad 9, present results as mean ± standard deviation, compare groups using an unpaired t‑test, and consider p < 0.05 as statistically significant.
